assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: coverage-led regression-report intake and disposition of every finding and uncovered user-visible surface
assessments.rationale: This is a full feature-delivery pipeline. It includes code review and testing but does not provide a method to consume the supplied coverage-led regression report, verify every finding, or produce the required complete disposition ledger.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: current-checkout verification and remediation of software behavior regressions
assessments.rationale: This workflow reviews England and Wales civil witness evidence rather than software behavior, repository changes, or regression-report findings, so it cannot carry out the requested review and fixes.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: verification and remediation of a coverage-led software regression report against the current checkout
assessments.rationale: This is an adversarial pre-specification proposal review. It does not consume a regression report, trace current behavior, fix proven regressions, or account for uncovered behavior areas.
assessments.source_anchor: Give a constructive adversarial review of a completed proposal before specifications and design.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: software repository review, regression verification, and code-change disposition workflow
assessments.rationale: The skill runs gene-set enrichment analysis on ranked gene lists, which has no operational support for reviewing a current code checkout or resolving behavior-regression findings.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: regression-specific handling of user-visible findings, behavior graph deltas, and regression coverage ledger
assessments.rationale: It supplies evidence-led intake, a complete disposition process, behavior-parity checks, and unstaged fixes; however it is scoped to thermo structural-quality reports and redirects material user-visible behavior risk to regression-review, so the supplied regression gate is not handled natively.

It directly consumes a coverage-led regression-review report, verifies every user-visible finding and uncovered surface against the current checkout, fixes only proven regressions, requires a complete disposition ledger, and leaves staging untouched.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: a workflow for user-visible regression findings rather than implementation-shortcut ownership findings
assessments.rationale: Although it uses a ledgered review process, this skill is scoped to hack-risk and ownership reports and explicitly directs user-visible behavior concerns to regression-review; applying it would use the wrong gate semantics.
assessments.source_anchor: Use `regression-review` instead when the concern is user-visible behavior rather than implementation shortcuts.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: software regression-report verification and current-checkout remediation
assessments.rationale: This workflow evaluates and writes formal RFP responses; a compliance matrix is not a process for verifying user-visible software regressions or fixing proven behavior breaks.
